settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: We deliver all over Pakistan in 3 to 4 working days, Monday to Friday. Remote areas may take longer.

settings.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
settings.answer: Yes. Cash on Delivery is available in all cities and towns across Pakistan.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Cash on Delivery, bank transfer, Easypaisa, and JazzCash.

settings.question: Can I exchange my order if the size is wrong?
settings.answer: Yes. You can exchange within 7 days of delivery for a different size or colour, if it is in stock. The item must be unworn, unwashed, and have its tags on. For size or colour exchanges, you pay the courier charge to send the item back to us.

settings.question: What if I receive a wrong, damaged, or faulty item?
settings.answer: Message us on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery with clear photos and a short unboxing video. We will send a replacement and cover the return shipping.

settings.question: How do I choose my size?
settings.answer: Check the size guide on each product page for exact measurements. If you prefer a loose, relaxed fit, we suggest sizing up.

settings.question: Can I order by WhatsApp, or ask about my order?
settings.answer: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp to place an order or ask any question about your order. For a new order, send the item name, your size, and your delivery address.

settings.question: How do I wash my clothes?
settings.answer: Care instructions are on each product page.

settings.question: How can I get help?
settings.answer: Message us on WhatsApp at +92 370 6735800 (Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 12:00 AM), or email support@adotoffical.com.
